Pricing models (choose one when the pilot converts)

Set together with your team based on order volume — not a fixed public rate card yet.

ModelHow it works
Per order monitoredFlat fee per order reconciled, regardless of outcome
Per order recoveredPay only for orders Relay actually catches and helps fix
% of amount recoveredA share of the dollar value recovered per incident

Payment method

We deliberately don't collect card details through a self-serve form at this stage — with no live billing running yet, a "connect card" button here would just be decoration. Once your pilot converts to paid, we'll set up billing directly together (Stripe invoice or a metered subscription, your call).
